endorsements.quote: Models that do not fulfill the interpretability requirements are flagged and demoted in the Selection component so that they are no longer considered candidate models in the next bandit learning iteration.
AI/ML tools can have a more significant clinical impact if clinicians and multiple stakeholders could interpret the output based on the type of explanation they need.
Version control can ensure robust and technical governance steps with audit trail of the processes and monitoring of the system performance.

unlisted_practices: Integrate privacy-preserving techniques such as differential privacy into AI model development and make privacy a built-in design feature across the model life cycle.
Use an orchestration platform to deploy, scale, update, and remove AI models across sites, removing models that violate governance standards or have technical issues.
Select among competing AI models using a combined reward function that incorporates clinical value and privacy metrics.

screen.reason: The paper introduces an implementation framework for deploying, monitoring, and governing AI at scale in healthcare systems.
